title: InputNode's synthetic test seam only injects mouse buttons
body: The existing VIXEN_FAIL_SCENARIOS seam can inject only mouse-button events, so this lane had to add test-only key, cursor-position, and focus-loss methods to feed realistic input through InputNode's queue. A shared synthetic input-event harness would make engine tests cover key and mouse frames without bespoke per-node injection methods.

title: Queue defaults over-reserve short configure and test jobs
body: The baseline five-test bundle was queued at 2 credits and stayed blocked while only one short-lane token was free; it was canceled (exit 130) and passed with --credits 1. The CMake preset reconfigure was queued at 3 credits and waited about 15 minutes; it was canceled (exit 130) and the same configure completed with --credits 1. Add calibrated sizing for focused gtest batches and CMake configure jobs so lanes do not need manual credit overrides.

title: CodegenTool dotnet run does not honor artifacts path for launch
body: A worktree-safe dotnet run --project ... --artifacts-path <worktree> restored and built CodegenTool into the artifacts directory, then tried launching the apphost from the pinned source snapshot's default bin/Release/net8.0 path and failed with ENOENT. Running the generated DLL directly with the same OctreeConfig --check arguments passed. Provide a documented worktree-safe run command or make the runner launch the artifacts-path DLL.
